tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Return every portfolio project (title, brief description, lifecycle, tech stack). Use get_project for the full body + screenshots.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full project detail — full description, tech stack, links, status.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Published posts, newest first. Returns metadata only — call get_post for the full body.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Full post metadata by slug (MDX body is served by the app routes).

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Employment, education, projects, certifications, and awards — the full timeline.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Bo's name, bio, current role, social links. The canonical 'who is this person' summary.

tools.name: get_tech_stack
tools.description: Technologies Bo works with, grouped by category.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Current GitHub contributions + LeetCode stats. Changes throughout the day — call fresh each time rather than caching.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
